Tariff Costs Fell Heavily On Americans

CBP collected roughly $166 billion under IEEPA. The Congressional Budget Office said in August that most would be refunded during fiscal 2026. Reuters reported in July that $71 billion had already been returned in May and June, while Warren’s office said almost $100 billion had gone back to companies.
